scientific_limitation: The target represents source-recorded abundance categories and is not a validated future HAB-risk or early-warning target.

target_definition.name: observed_abundance_category
target_definition.formulation: Multiclass source-reported contemporaneous Karenia brevis abundance category
target_definition.binary_risk_status: No directly validated binary HAB-risk target was established from the available NOAA fields.
target_definition.rule: Copy CATEGORY verbatim when it is documented, organism is Karenia/brevis, cell-count unit is cells/L, count parses finitely and CELLCOUNT_QA is 1 or 5; otherwise blank target with explicit status. No numerical bin thresholds are inferred.
target_definition.quality_policy: QA=1 source good; QA=5 upstream converted, retained with caution in metadata; QA=9 and undocumented/missing QA excluded from supervised-label eligibility only. This is a project eligibility policy, not a NOAA-mandated filter.

preprocessing: Group selection/cycles then training-fitted median+indicators; scaling only logistic; refit pool train+validation only
interpretation_method: Final refitted forest impurity-based model-associated feature importance; biased by correlations/feature cardinality; not causal
limitations: Same previously examined 2023–2024 test reused by explicit Phase 5 design, not independent external validation
Phase 4 descriptive error audit does not establish causal failure mechanism
Engineered group bundles cyclic encoding and removal of absolute year, not an isolated intervention
Sampling/site/time dependence, missingness and source-category quality persist
No validated future HAB-risk, toxicity, health-risk or early-warning capability
